scripts.dev: npm run build:sdk && npm run dev --workspace @pqc-wallet/web
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build --workspace @pqc-wallet/web
scripts.test: npm run build:sdk && tsx --test tests/*.test.ts tests/*.test.tsx
scripts.build:program: npm run build:program:sbf && npm run build:program:idl
scripts.build:program:idl: anchor idl build --program-name wallet --out target/wallet.json --out-ts target/wallet.ts -- --locked --jobs 3 && node scripts/sync-idl.mjs
scripts.test:validator: npm run build:program && npm run build:sdk && tsx --test --test-concurrency=1 tests/integration/vault.test.ts
